posts.title: If You Build It, They Probably Won’t Come
posts.description: Except they usually don’t. The problem is that your prospective customers are busy doing their actual jobs. Most of them don’t know your product exists, and even if somebody sends them a link, investigating a new piece of software is just another thing on an already long list. posts.title: Designing Fast and Slow
posts.description: Designers tend to prefer System 2. We want to slow things down, look at the problem from several angles, do some research and test a few models before committing. We often wait until we feel 90 per cent sure before pulling the trigger.
